lesson_plan.overview: Introduction to voltage, current, resistance, and their relationship (V=IR)

modules.title: Basic Concepts: V, I, and R

teaching_turn.spoken_text: Soch lo ek paani ka pipe hai. Voltage wahi pressure hai jo paani ko push karta hai. Samjhe?

interactive_prompt.question_text: Agar pressure (voltage) badhega, toh paani (current) ka kya hoga?

student_turn.response_text: Paani tez bahega, matlab current badhega?

evaluation.pedagogical_rationale: Student correctly mapped increased pressure to increased current.

adaptation.adaptation_context: Move on to resistance acting as a blockage in the pipe.
